Muffin Unboxing. Stripe is filming Muffin unboxing a dump truck toy, but she struggles to stay focused.
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Animated adventure comedy series. Someone's stopped the samba at the Rio carnival! Can the Go Jetters fix the glitch?
The Tale of the Spilled Milk. Animated series. When Peter, Lily and Benjamin accidentally spill Mittens's milk, they launch a daring mission to replace it.

Cliffhanger. Felix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo's tops can reach him. They will need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!
Let's Get Moving. Cor, it's so cold out! Time to warm up with my Let's Get Moving Challenge.

Slide. Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

Baking Mad. Flutter helps Brinicle with his brioche baking for an exam, but the dough expands to a colossal size.

Episode 11. Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Flamboyant ballroom dancer Enrico Paso Doble gets distracted by a window that needs cleaning.
The Lost Voice. It's the day of the pups' assembly, and Dodge forgets to learn the words of the song he's performing.
Elsa's Guyanese Fishcakes. Elsa is making a traditional Guyanese recipe using salt fish, potatoes and chives.

Diwali. In this episode, we follow Deeya as she celebrates the Hindu festival of light, Diwali.
Holiday Help. Ava offers to repair Miss Hoolie's bike, but a bigger challenge quickly arises.
The Fashion Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee's uniform is getting old and worn out. It's time he made himself a new outfit.

The Vegetable Robbery! When their garden vegetables are stolen, Cosima and Big Lizard become detectives.

Funfair. Ziff leads Pipp and Button to a fairground adventure, with help from faithful Bertie.
Quiet and Loud. Mr Tumble tries to keep quiet, as Grandad Tumble is having a nap.

Fifi's Delivery Service. Fifi needs to exercise but has a cart full of pies to deliver. Zog and the doctors must help her before her creaking bones turn to stone forever.
Cafe. Bluey learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.
Mae, Bee and the Bearded Bake. Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing that turn them 500 years old!
Sick of Being Sick. Tralala is stuck at home sick, but Batty won't give up trying to play with her.

Cleo Nibbles. A soul singer is coming to perform in the garden, but no one knows what they look like.

Highest Highs, Lowest Lows. Josh Gates recounts members' death-defying exploits! Two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific and a pilot skydives from the edge of space. S1, Ep1

Marco Polo: The Dunphys move into a cramped hotel room while their house is getting treated for mould.

Capri: In Eagle Rock, California, Gordon helps Capri, a restaurant in a rut that's owned by identical twins Jim and Jeff and is closed more often than it's open.
Brand new series - Firenze: At family Italian Firenze, the leadership's lacking, the pasta's a disaster and the chef can't even mash a potato. And then Gordon finds a dead mouse.
The Fresh Prince Project: Iconic 90s sitcom starring Will Smith. Cool cat Will's life gets flipped, turned upside down when he moves in with his auntie and uncle in Bel-Air.
Bang the Drum, Ashley: Uncle Phil wants Ashley to continue with her violin lessons, but Will has other ideas.
Clubba Hubba: Will wants to date a girl at the country club, but first he must impress her snobbish father. Can Carlton, Geoffrey and Uncle Phil teach him how to be a gentleman?
Not with My Pig, You Don't: When Uncle Phil wins a prestigious award, his parents come to visit and embarrass him with stories of his poor rural background and his pet pig.
Homeboy, Sweet Homeboy: Will's friend from Philadelphia, Ice Tray (guest star Don Cheadle), visits him in Bel-Air and takes a shine to Hilary, much to her parents' dismay.
It's 'Free-From' Week! Gluten-free, dairy-free and vegan: the bakes are free-from, but who proves that different is still delicious? And who'll be set free from the tent?
Homer the Heretic: Homer has a vision from God and decides to start his own religion, which doesn't go down too well with the neighbours.
Lisa the Beauty Queen: Lisa wins second place in a beauty contest.
Treehouse of Horror III: Lisa, Grampa and Bart tell scary stories at their Halloween party. A Krusty doll comes alive. Mr Burns heads to Skull Island. Bart raises the dead.
Itchy and Scratchy: The Movie: While Homer and Marge are at parents' evening, Bart breaks the babysitter's teeth. So Homer vows never to let him see the Itchy and Scratchy film.
Marge Gets a Job: When Marge gets a job at the power plant, Mr Burns falls in love with her and invites her over to dinner, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them.
Homer's Enemy: A new power plant employee who's struggled to build a decent life is incensed that someone as foolish as Homer could seem so affluent. Bart buys a factory.
The Simpsons Spin-Off Showcase: Troy McClure hosts a vision of the future of The Simpsons, in which Chief Wiggum becomes private detective Wiggum, P.I.
(2007) Animated comedy. When Homer's love for a pig causes world-threatening pollution, Springfield gets enclosed in a huge dome. D'oh! Will he do the decent thing and save his neighbours?

Treehouse of Horror III: Lisa, Grampa and Bart tell scary stories at their Halloween party. A Krusty doll comes alive. Mr Burns heads to Skull Island. Bart raises the dead.
Itchy and Scratchy: The Movie: While Homer and Marge are at parents' evening, Bart breaks the babysitter's teeth. So Homer vows never to let him see the Itchy and Scratchy film.
Marge Gets a Job: When Marge gets a job at the power plant, Mr Burns falls in love with her and invites her over to dinner, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them.
Homer's Enemy: A new power plant employee who's struggled to build a decent life is incensed that someone as foolish as Homer could seem so affluent. Bart buys a factory.
The Simpsons Spin-Off Showcase: Troy McClure hosts a vision of the future of The Simpsons, in which Chief Wiggum becomes private detective Wiggum, P.I.

p.t: The Great New Year Bake Off
p.d: Grab a dram, as Scottish bakers from across the years celebrate Hogmanay in the tent! Whose Technical will fall short? And whose cranachan will see them crowned as 2025's first star baker?
Grade School Confidential: Principal Skinner and Mrs Krabappel embark on a torrid affair but have to bribe Bart to keep the whole thing a secret.
The Canine Mutiny: Bart buys Laddie, an amazing new dog, with a credit card that's accidentally been sent to Santa's Little Helper.
The Old Man and the Lisa: Mr Burns loses all his money and employs Lisa to help him earn back his fortune. But they don't see eye to eye over ethical issues.
In Marge We Trust: Homer discovers that a Japanese dishwashing powder company is using his face as its logo. And Marge dishes out advice to the church's parishioners.
Kamp Krusty: Bart fakes his school report so that Homer will let him and Lisa go to Kamp Krusty. But the summer camp turns out to be a sweatshop and Bart leads an uprising...
A Streetcar Named Marge: Homer's boorishness inspires Marge to give the performance of a lifetime in a musical version of A Streetcar Named Desire.
(2004) Jamie Lee Curtis and Tim Allen fall out of love with Christmas when their daughter leaves home. But they live in the most Yule-loving suburb ever, and Dan Ackroyd won't let it lie.
(1996) Festive all-action comedy. Arnold Schwarzenegger is on a mission to get his son (Jake Lloyd) the must-have Christmas toy, Turbo Man. But it's sold out everywhere...
Natalie Cassidy, Chris Bisson, Dean Gaffney, Shobna Gulati and Sheree Murphy take on three festive challenges. Who'll just about cobble something together, and who'll be Queen Vic-torious?
The Goggleboxers tuck in to the best Christmas TV, from Gladiators Celebrity Special to Corrie, Michael McIntyre's Christmas Wheel, First Dates at Christmas and much more.
What do the Goggleboxers think of Celebrity Bear Hunt, The Apprentice, Go Back to Where You Came From, Michael McIntyre's Big Show and Boarders?
The Goggleboxers watch Gladiators, The White Lotus, The Apprentice, Celebrity Bear Hunt, The Fear Clinic: Face Your Phobia, and Batch from Scratch: Cooking for Less.
Charlotte says she has no gender boundaries but when her date, Charlie, tells her that he's a trans man, Charlotte is uncharacteristically speechless, at least initially...
Eccentric student Louisa, who went to an all-girls boarding school and says she can't flirt, meets Will, who was once the 'token fat child' but lost weight and gained confidence.

The One in an Aquarium: Essex groom Gary plans an aquatic wedding 200 miles from home. But Lauren hopes for a home counties service. Will Gary's underwater dream sink without a trace?
A Wall Street Thanksgiving: Murray has to intervene when Marvin reveals that he's become a stockbroker and convinces Barry and his friends to invest money with him.
An allegation shakes Abigail. And as shockwaves ripple through the village, is this the end of Cindy and Imran's tragic love story?
Marco Polo: The Dunphys move into a cramped hotel room while their house is getting treated for mould.
Café Kingston: In California, Gordon visits Jamaican restaurant Café Kingston. He meets micromanaging owner Dr Una Morris, who's also a radiotherapist.
Capri: In Eagle Rock, California, Gordon helps Capri, a restaurant in a rut that's owned by identical twins Jim and Jeff and is closed more often than it's open.
Brand new series - Firenze: At family Italian Firenze, the leadership's lacking, the pasta's a disaster and the chef can't even mash a potato. And then Gordon finds a dead mouse.

Bang the Drum, Ashley: Uncle Phil wants Ashley to continue with her violin lessons, but Will has other ideas.
Clubba Hubba: Will wants to date a girl at the country club, but first he must impress her snobbish father. Can Carlton, Geoffrey and Uncle Phil teach him how to be a gentleman?
Not with My Pig, You Don't: When Uncle Phil wins a prestigious award, his parents come to visit and embarrass him with stories of his poor rural background and his pet pig.
Homeboy, Sweet Homeboy: Will's friend from Philadelphia, Ice Tray (guest star Don Cheadle), visits him in Bel-Air and takes a shine to Hilary, much to her parents' dismay.

The Terminator Decoupling. The gang is thrilled to see Summer Glau is also aboard their train to San Francisco. Sheldon frets over having forgotten a paper he wants to present. S2, Ep17
The Work Song Nanocluster. Penny's business selling hair accessories out of her apartment gets out of hand when an over-caffeinated Sheldon takes charge. S2, Ep18
The Dead Hooker Juxtaposition. Penny feels threatened when another sexy woman moves into the apartment building and angered when she senses the guys are being taken advantage of. S2, Ep19
The Hofstadter Isotope. A fellow comic book enthusiast's hitting on Penny leads to Leonard, Raj and Howard going to a bar's Ladies' Night. S2, Ep20
The Vegas Renormalization. Leonard and Raj take Wolowitz to Las Vegas to help him get over his break-up. Sheldon locks himself out and has only one other place to stay: Penny's. S2, Ep21
Classified Material Turbulence. Stuart asks Leonard's advice for a date with Penny. Wolowitz realises there's an error in a toilet he designed for the International Space Station. S2, Ep22
The Monopolar Expedition. The guys receive a prestigious offer to work over the summer at the North Pole, and Penny's resultant behaviour leaves Leonard unsure if he should go. S2, Ep23
The Electric Can Opener. Discovering Leonard, Raj and Howard fudged the results of his Arctic research expedition, a disgraced Sheldon heads home to Texas. S3, Ep1
The Jiminy Conjecture. Sheldon and Howard wager comic books over a cricket's species. Meanwhile, a less-than-perfect romantic night agonizes Leonard and Penny. S3, Ep2
The Gothowitz Deviation. Howard takes Raj along to check out the Goth dating scene. Sheldon uses chocolate as part of a behaviour modification experiment on Penny. S3, Ep3
The Pirate Solution. Facing a return to India, Raj needs a job desperately enough to consider working for Sheldon. Howard becomes a third wheel to Leonard and Penny. S3, Ep4
Creepy Candy Coating Corollary. Sheldon looks forward to squaring off against a Star Trek actor in a fantasy card game tournament. Wolowitz cashes in on an old pact with Leonard. S3, Ep5
The Cornhusker Vortex. Hoping to fit in with Penny's football-loving friends, Leonard gets tutored in the sport by Sheldon. Raj is furious over the loss of his patang. S3, Ep6
The Guitarist Amplification. Leonard and Penny's first big fight sees Sheldon playing mediator due to childhood trauma that means he can't be around loud verbal conflicts. S3, Ep7
The Vengeance Formulation. Barry Kripke pranks Sheldon during his spot on NPR, leaving him wanting vengeance. Bernadette pressures Wolowitz to define their relationship. S3, Ep9
Stucco On You. Bob suffers from mysterious open-wound sores all over his body. Virginia can't wait to have her lump removed. Tom is desperate to find a cure for his itchy skin. S4, Ep15
My Octopus Lipoma. Steven's bump is so large, his daughter thinks he is growing a monster on his back. Ethan suffers from an irritating rash in an awkward place on his body. S4, Ep16
Fast Times At Nevus High. John lost his sight at a young age and soon after began growing lumps on his body. Lynette has hundreds of pebble-sized bumps on her arms, chest, and belly. S4, Ep17
Warning: Cystem Shutdown! Gerard has nearly a hundred lumps varying in size all over his body. Eric has a large bump on his head that he calls his 'on/off button.' S2, Ep10
peh-DUN-kyo-LAY-ted. Traci's confidence was destroyed after years of bullying about the bumps that have plagued her face for 20 years. Ravon has a unique dangling growth on his leg. S2, Ep11
The Diane P Episode. Chloe is dress shopping with her mum, but worries her voice won't be heard. And, Diane has waited 25 years to go dress shopping for her wedding to Kathy. S2, Ep22
Rena & Lee's Story. Since meeting at a bariatric rehab centre in 2006, Lee and Rena's weight has skyrocketed. The couple now makes a second attempt to save their lives. S6, Ep1
The Marianna Episode. Marianna has lost 5 stone for her wedding, yet still lacks confidence about her appearance. Jo and Al find a solution to make her feel amazing on the big day. S1, Ep19
The Aimee W Episode. Helen never wears dresses and is anxious about choosing the right gown. And, Jo and Alison manage a last-minute refit for bride Aimee after surprise weight loss. S2, Ep1
The Jacqui K Episode. Third-time bride Janine hopes to finally find a gown with a wow factor but will her mum approve? Jacqui worries that her chosen dress can't contain a baby-bump! S2, Ep2

Pineapple And Male Friendship. After being released from the psychiatric hospital, Dr. Sturgis unexpectedly breaks up with Meemaw. S3, Ep5
A Parasol And A Hell Of An Arm. A church carnival leads Missy to try out for the baseball team. Meanwhile, Meemaw struggles after her breakup with Dr. Sturgis. S3, Ep6
Pongo Pygmaeus And Spitting. Sheldon starts the first internet flame war, and Meemaw is unhappy when George spends time with her new boyfriend. S3, Ep7
The Sin Of Greed. The university tries to recruit Sheldon, through George. Georgie gets a job working for Meemaw's new boyfriend. Mary decides to rid her home of greed. S3, Ep8
A Party Invitation, Football. Mary gets Pastor Jeff involved when Sheldon isn't invited to Billy's birthday party. George, meanwhile, has 'male-bonding time' with Dr. Sturgis. S3, Ep9
Teenager Soup. Sheldon fakes being sick to avoid a swim test at school. Meanwhile, Dr. Sturgis spies on Meemaw's new boyfriend. S3, Ep10
A New Scoreboard. Georgie and Fagenbacher go head-to-head when Fagenbacher tries to sabotage Georgie's attempt to honour his dad. S2, Ep18
Little Schmoozin'. Georgie's plan to get on the news sparks a feud between Mandy and a rival weathergirl. Meanwhile, Mandy tries to use the conflict to help her career. S2, Ep19
The Gorilla Experiment. Penny seeks Sheldon's help to better comprehend Leonard's physics work. Wolowitz sees green when Leonard invites Bernadette to watch an experiment. S3, Ep10
The Maternal Congruence. A Christmas visit from his mother has Leonard discovering she's kept a lot of news from him that she shares with Sheldon. S3, Ep11
The Psychic Vortex. Leonard is aghast to find out that Penny believes in psychics. Sheldon tries to assist Koothrappali in picking up a girl at a university party. S3, Ep12
The Bozeman Reaction. A robbery of their apartment sees Leonard and Sheldon call on their friends to devise a security system. S3, Ep13
The Einstein Approximation. Stuck on the solution to a physics problem, Sheldon tries different methods to change his thinking, including working at The Cheesecake Factory. S3, Ep14
The Large Hadron Collision. When Leonard is offered a trip to Switzerland on Valentine's Day to see a particle accelerator, he must choose between taking Penny or Sheldon. S3, Ep15
The Excelsior Acquisition. An appearance in traffic court comes at the worst possible time for Sheldon, the same day Stan Lee is appearing at the comic book store. S3, Ep16
The Precious Fragmentation. The guys go to a garage sale and find a ring from the Lord of the Rings films, and the rare find threatens their friendship. S3, Ep17
The Pants Alternative. Sheldon's fear of speaking in front of large groups threatens his ability to accept an award, so the gang tries to help him prepare for the big night. S3, Ep18
The Wheaton Recurrence. Sheldon squares off at the bowling alley against nemesis Wil Wheaton. Leonard's miffed over Penny's response when he says, 'I love you.' S3, Ep19
The Spaghetti Catalysis. Following Leonard and Penny's break up, Sheldon tries to hide from Leonard and the gang that he had a friendly spaghetti dinner at Penny's. S3, Ep20
The Plimpton Stimulation. Sheldon hosts a visiting female physicist, but her intelligence seems matched by her libido. S3, Ep21
The Staircase Implementation. A squabble over the thermostat setting leads to Leonard going over to Penny's and recounting the story of how he met and moved in with Sheldon. S3, Ep22
The Lunar Excitation. Howard and Raj set Sheldon up on an Internet dating site. Penny discovers that she can't go back to dating dumb jocks after dating Leonard. S3, Ep23
The Robotic Manipulation. Howard uses a robotic arm for his own pleasure. Sheldon goes on a date with Amy Farrah Fowler, and Penny finds herself accompanying them. S4, Ep1
Cruciferous Veg Amplification. Sheldon calculates that he'll be dead before technology exists to download his consciousness into a robot, so he goes on a healthy-living binge. S4, Ep2
The Zazzy Substitution. Sheldon breaks up with Amy Farrah Fowler, and the guys worry when he starts replacing her with cats. S4, Ep3
The Hot Troll Deviation. Wolowitz is embarrassed when a secret of his is revealed, and Sheldon and Raj battle at work. S4, Ep4
The Desperation Emanation. Sheldon meets Amy's mum and comes to the realisation he no longer wants to see Amy, and Leonard realises everyone is in a relationship except for him. S4, Ep5
The Irish Pub Formulation. When Raj's sister has a one-day layover, he forbids the others from hooking up with her, unaware she and Leonard already did long ago. S4, Ep6
The Maternal Capacitance. A visit from Leonard's mother ends up bringing him and Penny closer. S2, Ep15
The Cushion Saturation. Paintball leads to a squabble between Sheldon and Penny as well as romance between Howard and Leslie. S2, Ep16
The Terminator Decoupling. The gang is thrilled to see Summer Glau is also aboard their train to San Francisco. Sheldon frets over having forgotten a paper he wants to present. S2, Ep17
The Work Song Nanocluster. Penny's business selling hair accessories out of her apartment gets out of hand when an over-caffeinated Sheldon takes charge. S2, Ep18
The Dead Hooker Juxtaposition. Penny feels threatened when another sexy woman moves into the apartment building and angered when she senses the guys are being taken advantage of. S2, Ep19
The Hofstadter Isotope. A fellow comic book enthusiast's hitting on Penny leads to Leonard, Raj and Howard going to a bar's Ladies' Night. S2, Ep20
The Vegas Renormalization. Leonard and Raj take Wolowitz to Las Vegas to help him get over his break-up. Sheldon locks himself out and has only one other place to stay: Penny's. S2, Ep21
Classified Material Turbulence. Stuart asks Leonard's advice for a date with Penny. Wolowitz realises there's an error in a toilet he designed for the International Space Station. S2, Ep22
The Monopolar Expedition. The guys receive a prestigious offer to work over the summer at the North Pole, and Penny's resultant behaviour leaves Leonard unsure if he should go. S2, Ep23
The Electric Can Opener. Discovering Leonard, Raj and Howard fudged the results of his Arctic research expedition, a disgraced Sheldon heads home to Texas. S3, Ep1
The Jiminy Conjecture. Sheldon and Howard wager comic books over a cricket's species. Meanwhile, a less-than-perfect romantic night agonizes Leonard and Penny. S3, Ep2
The Gothowitz Deviation. Howard takes Raj along to check out the Goth dating scene. Sheldon uses chocolate as part of a behaviour modification experiment on Penny. S3, Ep3
The Pirate Solution. Facing a return to India, Raj needs a job desperately enough to consider working for Sheldon. Howard becomes a third wheel to Leonard and Penny. S3, Ep4
Creepy Candy Coating Corollary. Sheldon looks forward to squaring off against a Star Trek actor in a fantasy card game tournament. Wolowitz cashes in on an old pact with Leonard. S3, Ep5
The Cornhusker Vortex. Hoping to fit in with Penny's football-loving friends, Leonard gets tutored in the sport by Sheldon. Raj is furious over the loss of his patang. S3, Ep6
The Guitarist Amplification. Leonard and Penny's first big fight sees Sheldon playing mediator due to childhood trauma that means he can't be around loud verbal conflicts. S3, Ep7
The Vengeance Formulation. Barry Kripke pranks Sheldon during his spot on NPR, leaving him wanting vengeance. Bernadette pressures Wolowitz to define their relationship. S3, Ep9
Stucco On You. Bob suffers from mysterious open-wound sores all over his body. Virginia can't wait to have her lump removed. Tom is desperate to find a cure for his itchy skin. S4, Ep15
My Octopus Lipoma. Steven's bump is so large, his daughter thinks he is growing a monster on his back. Ethan suffers from an irritating rash in an awkward place on his body. S4, Ep16
Fast Times At Nevus High. John lost his sight at a young age and soon after began growing lumps on his body. Lynette has hundreds of pebble-sized bumps on her arms, chest, and belly. S4, Ep17
Warning: Cystem Shutdown! Gerard has nearly a hundred lumps varying in size all over his body. Eric has a large bump on his head that he calls his 'on/off button.' S2, Ep10
peh-DUN-kyo-LAY-ted. Traci's confidence was destroyed after years of bullying about the bumps that have plagued her face for 20 years. Ravon has a unique dangling growth on his leg. S2, Ep11
The Diane P Episode. Chloe is dress shopping with her mum, but worries her voice won't be heard. And, Diane has waited 25 years to go dress shopping for her wedding to Kathy. S2, Ep22
Rena & Lee's Story. Since meeting at a bariatric rehab centre in 2006, Lee and Rena's weight has skyrocketed. The couple now makes a second attempt to save their lives. S6, Ep1
The Marianna Episode. Marianna has lost 5 stone for her wedding, yet still lacks confidence about her appearance. Jo and Al find a solution to make her feel amazing on the big day. S1, Ep19
The Aimee W Episode. Helen never wears dresses and is anxious about choosing the right gown. And, Jo and Alison manage a last-minute refit for bride Aimee after surprise weight loss. S2, Ep1
The Jacqui K Episode. Third-time bride Janine hopes to finally find a gown with a wow factor but will her mum approve? Jacqui worries that her chosen dress can't contain a baby-bump! S2, Ep2

Challenging each other to discern fact from fiction here are Greg Davies, Konnie Huq, Phil Tufnell and Marcus Brigstocke. With regulars Rob Brydon, David Mitchell and Lee Mack.
Rob Brydon hosts the comedy panel show - joining team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are Rhod Gilbert, Ronan Keating, Ellie Taylor and Georgia Toffolo.
Cunning celebs attempt to tell fact from fiction. Rob Brydon welcomes regulars David Mitchell and Lee Mack plus Mackenzie Crook, Chris Packham, Victoria Coren and Rhod Gilbert.
Rob Brydon presides over the wittily deceptive comedy panel show. David Mitchell and Lee Mack are joined by Patrick Kielty, Bernard Cribbins, Deborah Meaden and Mark Watson.
Rob Brydon chairs the deceptive comedy panel game. David Mitchell and Lee Mack bluff and banter with Sarah Millican, Holly Walsh, Julian Clary and the late Ronnie Corbett.
The Unseen Bits: The gags that didn't make it to TV first time round but will still make you giggle - Rob Brydon hosts the panel show in which fact and fiction are indistinguishable.

p.t: Jack Dee's Help Me Tiny Big Brain
p.d: The junior geniuses direct their comedy teammates - Johnny Vegas, Sophie Willan and Lucy Beaumont - through a dog-wrangling logic puzzle and a vacuum cleaner-based maths conundrum.
Happy Holiday: Mike and Alison welcome the very first guests to their new B&B and are determined to get a glowing review, and Thomas is thrilled by the sudden attention from the Plaguers.
Speak As Ye Choose: Mary walks Julian through her journey of self-discovery and how she found her voice, and Thomas decides that he must go 'cold turkey' on his Alison addiction.
The Hardest Word: The spooks' thoughtless behaviour sends Alison into meltdown and prompts them to come up with a creative way to show her how truly sorry they are.
Gone Gone: Shocking news rocks Button House and a booking mix-up sees Mike and Alison forced to host an impromptu - and ill-prepared - children's birthday party.
Coffin: When Lee wakes up inside a coffin and can't remember how he got there, all he needs to do is keep Lucy in the dark as to his exact location and work out how to escape.
Train: Geoffrey and Wendy take Lee, Lucy, Toby and Anna for a trip on a vintage steam train for Lucy's birthday, but Lee's decision to play Poirot risks ruining the day.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
p.d: Jo Brand is guest host with comedian Susie McCabe and journalist Camilla Long joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news.
Poached Guests: A neighbour of Alison and Mike's spots a business opportunity which sparks an all-out war between them, and the ghosts find a surprising new friend.
Not Again: Mike and Alison reach boiling point over the B&B, Julian aims to prove he is more selfless than people think, and a new addition triggers frightening flashbacks for Robin.

p.t: Dave Gorman: Modern Life Is Goodish
p.d: Nobody Wants Vom on Their Cheerios: Amusing musings on 21st century life. Dave ponders whether people's behaviour is the same in the real world as it is online.
Two warring naturist cleaners dress for court in their birthday suits, and a disgruntled claimant is seeking damages for his broken drum.
Shopping from Home.
Shopping from Home.
Ipswich: Stop - hammer time! Auctioneer Sean Kelly and his hit reality show come to the UK. A mystery object sparks a bidding war. The gang scrap for an occult bin and a coffin.
New. Never Say Die: Bernie learns a harsh lesson as the gold prospectors continue to fight the elements along with one another in a bid to bring home a profit.
New. Run for the Narrows: Big Al tries an inventive way of getting gold, while Hiro battles beavers for precious sluicing water, making the miners' jobs even tougher.
New. Big Money Throwdown: Ken and Dennis are forced to make a dangerous journey for fuel when snow arrives early. Meanwhile, Karl wakes up to a frozen sluice plant and a broken pipe.
Cincinnati: With a total disregard for their welfare, amateur drivers hurtle down Cincinnati's steep streets in their nutty homemade contraptions - makes for great TV, though!
Barcelona: The Lewis Hamiltons of the future - alright, maybe that's pushing it - race their gravity-powered motors through the streets of Barcelona. Farcical crashes guaranteed.
Yangtze River: Guy Martin builds his own electric motorbike in a factory in Chongqing before visiting the world's biggest public toilet and heading along the Yangtze towards Shanghai.
Peru: Celebs Ben Fogle and Hugh Dennis face risky hairpin bends and terrifying 2,000ft drops as they wind their way through the Peruvian Andes in search of a fabled lost city.

Latin America: Simon Reeve visits South America, where he learns how the Galapagos Islands are under threat from tourists and meets remote indigenous tribes in Brazil.
New. Guy joins the Royal Marines at Camp Viking in Norway, 200 miles above the Arctic Circle, living with the commandos and training alongside them on the annual Cold Weather Warfare Course.
A pregnant mother with a chronic heart condition falls unwell, whilst Nancy grows suspicious of a young father's erratic behaviour. Matthew prepares for a visit from his father.

Death Comes To Marlow Part 1: A wealthy baronet dies alone in his study the day before his wedding and Judith, Becks and Suzie find themselves at the centre of another mystery.

p.t: My Family Xmas 2003: Sixty Feet Under
p.d: A festive edition of the popular sitcom about the eccentric Harpers. The family are in London for some Christmas shopping, and end up stuck in a tube train.
Piers travels to Gadsden Correctional Facility to meet Ashley Humphrey, who shot barmaid Sandee Rozzo eight times in 2003 - a crime for which she is now serving 25 years.
Piers speaks with Sheila Davalloo, who has remained silent about the events surrounding the murder of Anna Lisa Raymundo for 14 years.
Another visit to the maternity ward at Liverpool Women's Hospital. Childhood friends Karra and Danny await the arrival of their third child.
Shopping from Home.
Anna and Darren treat a woman who is suffering from terminal cancer, and Jamie and Jason see a familiar face when they are called to the home of his elderly grandfather.
Sam and Tony are called to a woman suffering excruciating stomach pain, but soon find themselves dealing with a sudden seizure. Stef and Lee treat an excitable six-year-old.
Time is against ambulance crew mates Laura and Jason as they treat a 74-year-old woman who is having a stroke. Olly and V are called to a man whose heart is beating dangerously fast.
V and Ollie are faced with a dilemma when they're called to woman who has suffered a seizure but refuses to go to hospital. Rachel and Mick are called to assist the police with a prisoner.
Sam and Carla blue-light it to a man who's fallen badly at home and has a suspected spinal injury and Ash and Craig help a 12-year-old boy who has been attacked at his local fun fair.
Sam and Myles respond to a call for a man who's collapsed with severe breathlessness. Husband-and-wife crew mates Ann and Kev treat a homeless man who's been assaulted.
Paramedics collect a seriously injured man airlifted in from Wales, deal with a distressed pensioner who has taken a tumble, and treat a toddler struggling to breathe.
